# `task_batch_release`

**Release a reviewed ingestion batch.** Verify source approval, the live graph and its fidelity receipt before release.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `task_batch_release` |
| Side effect | `composite` |
| Idempotency | natural |
| Retry safe | yes |
| Timeout | none |
